data.title: Prepare v0.5.0-alpha.3 values and numeric protocols
data.body:
## Problem

Alpha.3 combines numeric protocols, complex values, container keys and constructor specialization. Its integrated release needs complete qualification before publication.

## Change

With ChatGPT assistance, prepare v0.5.0-alpha.3 and release notes, including enum repair #1496 and proof-adapter repairs #1498/#1501. Source inventories bind the retained compiler/runtime executions to the final integrated tree. Refs #1476.

## Validation

Current-head CI, Lint, Submission and CodeQL pass. The fresh 2,699-program census covers 196 storage selections and proves 25,816/25,816 strict storage obligations. All 38 denominator decreases are explained; independent final acceptance passes.

Fresh compiler/runtime fixed points, the 4,771-case IR comparison with zero new rejections, and three paired build-cost workloads retain their recorded source identities. All 562 IR differences are explained. Earlier failed census attempts remain preserved.

The accepted model limits remain explicit: 542 union reads, 409 payload obligations, three added GC gaps and one unknown-count Decimal field case. Independent agent reviews completed; automatic repair reviews failed for account quota. [Qualified evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/231e903a8b353ecb1595bed3002cecbc006f0d34/research/v0.5.0-alpha.3-qualification/README.md). Exact-main qualification and public artifact audits follow merge; publication is not claimed here.

Codecov provides highly integrated tools to group, merge, archive and compare coverage reports. Whether your team is comparing changes in a pull request or reviewing a single commit, Codecov will improve the code review workflow and quality.

## Code coverage done right.®

1. Upload coverage reports from your CI builds.
2. Codecov merges all builds and languages into one beautiful coherent report.
3. Get commit statuses, pull request comments and coverage overlay via our browser extension.

When Codecov merges your uploads it keeps track of the CI provider (inc. build details) and user specified context, e.g. `#unittest` ~ `#smoketest` or `#oldcode` ~ `#newcode`. You can track the `#unittest` coverage independently of other groups. [Learn more here](
http://docs.codecov.io/docs/flags)

Through **Codecov's Browser Extension** reports overlay directly in GitHub UI to assist in code review in [Chrome](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/codecov/gedikamndpbemklijjkncpnolildpbgo) or Firefox (https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/codecov/)

*Highly detailed* **pull request comments** and *customizable* **commit statuses** will improve your team's workflow and code coverage incrementally.

**File backed configuration** all through the `codecov.yml`. 

## FAQ
- Do you **merge multiple uploads** to the same commit? **Yes**
- Do you **support multiple languages** in the same project? **Yes**
- Can you **group coverage reports** by project and/or test type? **Yes**
- How does **pricing** work? Only paid users can view reports and post statuses/comments.

  issues:
    types: [opened, edited, reopened]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  statuses: write

concurrency:
  group: submission-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

  description:
    name: Check title and description
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate current metadata
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 tools/check_submission.py
